correctness.rationale: Squaring t_i=tau+v^-1 sqrt(|s_i-x|²+h²) gives exact 5-column linear design [2t_i,|s_i|²,s_ix,s_iy,1]. Five distinct circle stations force an affine time relation to have a degree-two trigonometric polynomial with 5 zeros, so its degree-two harmonic vanishes (slope b=0) and the degree-one harmonic forces x=0. For x=0, three distinct squared radii sample a strictly concave sqrt(z+h²), excluding affine rank loss. A circle gauge u→lambda u, x→x/lambda², h²→(R²+|x|²+h²)/lambda²-R²-|x|²/lambda^4 proves all-circle nonidentifiability. Two radii fail centrally. Independently computed rank 5 for central and two off-center positive-depth instances, with minimum singular values 0.01450,0.00771,0.00893; finite samples are supplementary.
